meta.name: vad-team-map20
meta.description: VAD agent team: A/B research+debate, C skeptical review, D implement+eval. Iterates the UCF-Crime VAD pipeline until full-eval temporal mAP>=0.20 (min 15 loops, versions v97+), minimizing per-video latency.

phases.title: Research
phases.detail: A and B independently research papers + codebase, each proposes one architecture-level idea

phases.title: Debate
phases.detail: A and B cross-critique, then synthesize one joint consensus proposal

phases.title: Review
phases.detail: C approves or rejects with feedback; up to 2 revision cycles

phases.title: Implement
phases.detail: D implements, runs smoke + full eval, saves versioned logs and report
